ModMetaData.name: Hold Open Opens Doors (No HugsLib) - Dev Build
ModMetaData.author: Pope Snowball, Sixdd6
ModMetaData.description:
"Hold Open" will immediately open/close doors, instead of waiting for a colonist to do it. Settings allow disabling of mod by door type and whether or not a powered door is receiving power.
This is a fork of Hold Open Opens Doors by Pope Snowball. It does not need HugsLib. Settings are in Options > Mod Settings.
